verses.original: וַנֵּ֜פֶן וַנִּסַּ֤ע הַמִּדְבָּ֙רָה֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יַם־ ס֔וּף כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֑י וַנָּ֥סָב אֶת־ הַר־ שֵׂעִ֖יר יָמִ֥ים רַבִּֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: wan·nê·p̄en wan·nis·sa‘ ham·miḏ·bā·rāh de·reḵ yam- sūp̄ ka·’ă·šer dib·ber Yah·weh ’ê·lāy wan·nā·sāḇ ’eṯ- har- śê·‘îr yā·mîm rab·bîm
verses.literal: Then we turned back and headed for the wilderness by way of the Red Sea as the LORD . . . had instructed me and for many days we wandered around Mount Seir
verses.literalPt: Então, voltamos e partimos para o deserto pelo caminho do mar Vermelho, como Jeová me falou; e muitos dias rodeamos o monte Seir.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: At this time the LORD said to me . . .
verses.literalPt: Jeová disse:

verses.original: רַב־ לָכֶ֕ם סֹ֖ב אֶת־ הָהָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה פְּנ֥וּ לָכֶ֖ם צָפֹֽנָה׃
verses.transliteration: raḇ- lā·ḵem sōḇ ’eṯ- hā·hār haz·zeh pə·nū lā·ḵem ṣā·p̄ō·nāh
verses.literal: You have been wandering around this hill country long enough turn to the north
verses.literalPt: Assaz tendes andado em roda deste monte; voltai-vos para o norte.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הָעָם֮ צַ֣ו לֵאמֹר֒ אַתֶּ֣ם עֹֽבְרִ֗ים בִּגְבוּל֙ אֲחֵיכֶ֣ם בְּנֵי־ עֵשָׂ֔ו הַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בְּשֵׂעִ֑יר וְיִֽירְא֣וּ מִכֶּ֔ם וְנִשְׁמַרְתֶּ֖ם מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- hā·‘ām ṣaw lê·mōr ’at·tem ‘ō·ḇə·rîm biḡ·ḇūl ’ă·ḥê·ḵem bə·nê- ‘ê·śāw hay·yō·šə·ḇîm bə·śê·‘îr wə·yî·rə·’ū mik·kem wə·niš·mar·tem mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: and command . . . the people You will pass through the territory of your brothers the descendants of Esau who live in Seir They will be afraid of you so you must be very careful
verses.literalPt: Ordena ao povo, dizendo: Vós ides passar pelo território de vossos irmãos, filhos de Esaú, que habitam em Seir. Terão medo de vós; portanto, guardai-vos bem.

verses.original: אַל־ תִּתְגָּר֣וּ בָ֔ם כִּ֠י לֹֽא־ אֶתֵּ֤ן לָכֶם֙ מֵֽאַרְצָ֔ם עַ֖ד מִדְרַ֣ךְ כַּף־ רָ֑גֶל כִּֽי־ יְרֻשָּׁ֣ה לְעֵשָׂ֔ו נָתַ֖תִּי אֶת־ הַ֥ר שֵׂעִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tiṯ·gā·rū ḇām kî lō- ’et·tên lā·ḵem mê·’ar·ṣām ‘aḏ miḏ·raḵ kap̄- rā·ḡel kî- yə·ruš·šāh lə·‘ê·śāw nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- har śê·‘îr
verses.literal: Do not provoke them for I will not give you any of their land not even a footprint . . . . . . because I have given Mount Seir to Esau as his possession
verses.literalPt: Não os provoqueis, porque não vos darei da sua terra nem sequer o que pisar a planta dum pé; pois a Esaú dei o monte Seir por possessão.

verses.original: אֹ֣כֶל תִּשְׁבְּר֧וּ מֵֽאִתָּ֛ם בַּכֶּ֖סֶף וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֑ם וְגַם־ מַ֜יִם תִּכְר֧וּ מֵאִתָּ֛ם בַּכֶּ֖סֶף וּשְׁתִיתֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·ḵel tiš·bə·rū mê·’it·tām bak·ke·sep̄ wa·’ă·ḵal·tem wə·ḡam- ma·yim tiḵ·rū mê·’it·tām bak·ke·sep̄ ū·šə·ṯî·ṯem
verses.literal: You are to pay them in silver for the food you eat and - the water you drink
verses.literalPt: Comprareis deles por dinheiro comida para comerdes e também deles comprareis água para beberdes.

verses.original: כִּי֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ בֵּֽרַכְךָ֗ בְּכֹל֙ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדֶ֔ךָ יָדַ֣ע לֶכְתְּךָ֔ אֶת־ הַמִּדְבָּ֥ר הַגָּדֹ֖ל הַזֶּ֑ה זֶ֣ה׀ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֗ה יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ עִמָּ֔ךְ לֹ֥א חָסַ֖רְתָּ דָּבָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: kî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā bê·raḵ·ḵā bə·ḵōl ma·‘ă·śêh yā·ḏe·ḵā yā·ḏa‘ leḵ·tə·ḵā ’eṯ- ham·miḏ·bār hag·gā·ḏōl haz·zeh zeh ’ar·bā·‘îm šā·nāh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ‘im·māḵ lō ḥā·sar·tā dā·ḇār
verses.literal: Indeed the LORD your God has blessed you in all the work of your hands He has watched over your journey through this vast wilderness The LORD your God has been with you these forty years and you have lacked nothing . . .
verses.literalPt: Pois Jeová, teu Deus, te há abençoado em toda a obra das tuas mãos; conheceu o teu caminho por este grande deserto; estes quarenta anos Jeová, teu Deus, tem estado contigo; nada te há faltado.

verses.original: וַֽנַּעֲבֹ֞ר מֵאֵ֧ת אַחֵ֣ינוּ בְנֵי־ עֵשָׂ֗ו הַיֹּֽשְׁבִים֙ בְּשֵׂעִ֔יר מִדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ הָֽעֲרָבָ֔ה מֵאֵילַ֖ת וּמֵעֶצְיֹ֣ן גָּ֑בֶרס וַנֵּ֙פֶן֙ וַֽנַּעֲבֹ֔ר דֶּ֖רֶךְ מִדְבַּ֥ר מוֹאָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wan·na·‘ă·ḇōr mê·’êṯ ’a·ḥê·nū ḇə·nê- ‘ê·śāw hay·yō·šə·ḇîm bə·śê·‘îr mid·de·reḵ hā·‘ă·rā·ḇāh mê·’ê·laṯ ū·mê·‘eṣ·yōn gå̄·ḇɛ·rs wan·nê·p̄en wan·na·‘ă·ḇōr de·reḵ miḏ·bar mō·w·’āḇ
verses.literal: So we passed by . . . our brothers the descendants of Esau who live in Seir We turned away from the Arabah road which comes up from Elath and Ezion-geber and traveled along the road of the Wilderness of Moab
verses.literalPt: Assim passamos de nossos irmãos, filhos de Esaú, que habitam em Seir, do caminho da Arabá, de Elate e de Eziom-Geber. Tendo voltado, passamos pelo caminho do deserto de Moabe.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י אֶל־ תָּ֙צַר֙ אֶת־ מוֹאָ֔ב וְאַל־ תִּתְגָּ֥ר בָּ֖ם מִלְחָמָ֑ה כִּ֠י לֹֽא־ אֶתֵּ֨ן לְךָ֤ מֵֽאַרְצוֹ֙ יְרֻשָּׁ֔ה כִּ֣י לִבְנֵי־ ל֔וֹט נָתַ֥תִּי אֶת־ עָ֖ר יְרֻשָּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ê·lay ’el- tå̄·ṣar ’eṯ- mō·w·’āḇ wə·’al- tiṯ·gār bām mil·ḥā·māh kî lō- ’et·tên lə·ḵā mê·’ar·ṣōw yə·ruš·šāh kî liḇ·nê- lō·wṭ nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- ‘ār yə·ruš·šāh
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to me Do not harass the Moabites or provoke them to war for I will not give you any of their land because I have given Ar to the descendants of Lot as their possession
verses.literalPt: Então, Jeová me disse: Não molestes a Moabe, nem lhe faças guerra, porque não te darei da sua terra por possessão; pois dei Ar em possessão aos filhos de Ló

verses.original: הָאֵמִ֥ים לְפָנִ֖ים יָ֣שְׁבוּ בָ֑הּ עַ֣ם גָּד֥וֹל וְרַ֛ב וָרָ֖ם כָּעֲנָקִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’ê·mîm lə·p̄ā·nîm yā·šə·ḇū ḇāh ‘am gā·ḏō·wl wə·raḇ wā·rām kā·‘ă·nā·qîm
verses.literal: The Emites used to live there a people great and many as tall as the Anakites
verses.literalPt: (Os emins dantes habitavam nela, povo grande, numeroso e alto, como os anaquins.

verses.original: רְפָאִ֛ים יֵחָשְׁב֥וּ אַף־ הֵ֖ם כָּעֲנָקִ֑ים וְהַמֹּ֣אָבִ֔ים יִקְרְא֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם אֵמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: rə·p̄ā·’îm yê·ḥā·šə·ḇū ’ap̄- hêm kā·‘ă·nā·qîm wə·ham·mō·’ā·ḇîm yiq·rə·’ū lā·hem ’ê·mîm
verses.literal: Like the Anakites they were also . . . regarded as Rephaim though the Moabites called them Emites
verses.literalPt: Também eles são considerados refains, como os anaquins; porém os moabitas lhes chamam emins.

verses.original: וּבְשֵׂעִ֞יר יָשְׁב֣וּ הַחֹרִים֮ לְפָנִים֒ וּבְנֵ֧י עֵשָׂ֣ו יִֽירָשׁ֗וּם וַיַּשְׁמִידוּם֙ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֔ם וַיֵּשְׁב֖וּ תַּחְתָּ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֧ר עָשָׂ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לְאֶ֙רֶץ֙ יְרֻשָּׁת֔וֹ אֲשֶׁר־ נָתַ֥ן יְהוָ֖ה לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·śê·‘îr yā·šə·ḇū ha·ḥō·rîm lə·p̄ā·nîm ū·ḇə·nê ‘ê·śāw yî·rā·šūm way·yaš·mî·ḏūm mip·pə·nê·hem way·yê·šə·ḇū taḥ·tām ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh yiś·rā·’êl lə·’e·reṣ yə·ruš·šā·ṯōw ’ă·šer- nā·ṯan Yah·weh lā·hem
verses.literal: The Horites used to live in Seir but the descendants of Esau drove them out They destroyed the Horites from before them and settled in their place just as Israel did in the land that the LORD gave them as their possession
verses.literalPt: Os horeus também habitavam dantes em Seir, mas os filhos de Esaú os desapossaram; e, tendo-os destruído diante de si, habitavam no lugar deles, assim como Israel fez à terra da sua possessão que Jeová lhes deu.).

verses.original: עַתָּ֗ה קֻ֛מוּ וְעִבְר֥וּ לָכֶ֖ם אֶת־ נַ֣חַל זָ֑רֶד וַֽנַּעֲבֹ֖ר אֶת־ נַ֥חַל זָֽרֶד׃
verses.transliteration: ‘at·tāh qu·mū wə·‘iḇ·rū lā·ḵem ’eṯ- na·ḥal zā·reḏ wan·na·‘ă·ḇōr ’eṯ- na·ḥal zā·reḏ
verses.literal: Now arise and cross over the Brook of Zered So we crossed over the Brook of Zered
verses.literalPt: Levantai-vos, agora, e passai a torrente de Zerede. Passamos, pois, a torrente de Zerede.

verses.original: וְהַיָּמִ֞ים אֲשֶׁר־ הָלַ֣כְנוּ׀ מִקָּדֵ֣שׁ בַּרְנֵ֗עַ עַ֤ד אֲשֶׁר־ עָבַ֙רְנוּ֙ אֶת־ נַ֣חַל זֶ֔רֶד שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנֶ֖ה שָׁנָ֑ה עַד־ תֹּ֨ם כָּל־ הַדּ֜וֹר אַנְשֵׁ֤י הַמִּלְחָמָה֙ מִקֶּ֣רֶב הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר נִשְׁבַּ֥ע יְהוָ֖ה לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hay·yā·mîm ’ă·šer- hā·laḵ·nū miq·qā·ḏêš bar·nê·a‘ ‘aḏ ’ă·šer- ‘ā·ḇar·nū ’eṯ- na·ḥal ze·reḏ šə·lō·šîm ū·šə·mō·neh šā·nāh ‘aḏ- tōm kāl- had·dō·wr ’an·šê ham·mil·ḥā·māh miq·qe·reḇ ham·ma·ḥă·neh ka·’ă·šer niš·ba‘ Yah·weh lā·hem
verses.literal: The time we spent traveling from Kadesh-barnea until we crossed over the Brook of Zered was thirty-eight . . . years until that entire generation of fighting men had perished from the camp as the LORD had sworn to them
verses.literalPt: Os dias em que caminhamos de Cades-Barneia até termos passado a torrente de Zerede foram trinta e oito anos; até que se extinguiu do meio do arraial toda a geração dos homens de guerra, como Jeová lhes havia jurado.

verses.original: וְגַ֤ם יַד־ יְהוָה֙ הָ֣יְתָה בָּ֔ם לְהֻמָּ֖ם מִקֶּ֣רֶב הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה עַ֖ד תֻּמָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam yaḏ- Yah·weh hā·yə·ṯāh bām lə·hum·mām miq·qe·reḇ ham·ma·ḥă·neh ‘aḏ tum·mām
verses.literal: Indeed the LORD’s hand was against them to eliminate them from the camp until they had all perished
verses.literalPt: Também a mão de Jeová foi contra eles, para os fazer perecer do meio do arraial, até serem extintos.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֨י כַאֲשֶׁר־ תַּ֜מּוּ כָּל־ אַנְשֵׁ֧י הַמִּלְחָמָ֛ה לָמ֖וּת מִקֶּ֥רֶב הָעָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḵa·’ă·šer- tam·mū kāl- ’an·šê ham·mil·ḥā·māh lā·mūṯ miq·qe·reḇ hā·‘ām
verses.literal: Now when . . . all the fighting men among the people had died
verses.literalPt: Quando todos os homens de guerra foram extintos pela morte dentre o povo,

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: the LORD said to me . . .
verses.literalPt: disse-me Jeová:

verses.original: אַתָּ֨ה עֹבֵ֥ר הַיּ֛וֹם אֶת־ גְּב֥וּל מוֹאָ֖ב אֶת־ עָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh ‘ō·ḇêr hay·yō·wm ’eṯ- gə·ḇūl mō·w·’āḇ ’eṯ- ‘ār
verses.literal: Today you are going to cross the border of Moab at Ar
verses.literalPt: Tu vais passar, hoje, o território de Moabe, a saber, Ar.

verses.original: וְקָרַבְתָּ֗ מ֚וּל בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן אַל־ תְּצֻרֵ֖ם וְאַל־ תִּתְגָּ֣ר בָּ֑ם כִּ֣י לֹֽא־ אֶ֠תֵּן מֵאֶ֨רֶץ בְּנֵי־ עַמּ֤וֹן לְךָ֙ יְרֻשָּׁ֔ה כִּ֥י לִבְנֵי־ ל֖וֹט נְתַתִּ֥יהָ יְרֻשָּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·qā·raḇ·tā mūl bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn ’al- tə·ṣu·rêm wə·’al- tiṯ·gār bām kî lō- ’et·tên mê·’e·reṣ bə·nê- ‘am·mō·wn lə·ḵā yə·ruš·šāh kî liḇ·nê- lō·wṭ nə·ṯat·tî·hā yə·ruš·šāh
verses.literal: But when you get close to the Ammonites . . . do not harass them . . . or provoke them for I will not give you any of the land of the Ammonites . . . - I have given it to the descendants of Lot as their possession
verses.literalPt: Quando chegares defronte dos filhos de Amom, não os molestes, nem lhes faças guerra; porque não te darei da terra dos filhos de Amom por possessão, pois a dei em possessão aos filhos de Ló

verses.original: אֶֽרֶץ־ רְפָאִ֥ים תֵּחָשֵׁ֖ב אַף־ הִ֑וא רְפָאִ֤ים יָֽשְׁבוּ־ בָהּ֙ לְפָנִ֔ים וְהָֽעַמֹּנִ֔ים יִקְרְא֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם זַמְזֻמִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’e·reṣ- rə·p̄ā·’îm tê·ḥā·šêḇ ’ap̄- hî rə·p̄ā·’îm yā·šə·ḇū- ḇāh lə·p̄ā·nîm wə·hā·‘am·mō·nîm yiq·rə·’ū lā·hem zam·zum·mîm
verses.literal: That too was regarded as the land of the Rephaim who used to live there . . . though the Ammonites called them Zamzummites
verses.literalPt: (Esta também é considerada terra de refains. Nela habitavam dantes refains, mas os amonitas lhes chamam zanzumins,

verses.original: עַ֣ם גָּד֥וֹל וְרַ֛ב וָרָ֖ם כָּעֲנָקִ֑ים וַיַּשְׁמִידֵ֤ם יְהוָה֙ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֔ם וַיִּירָשֻׁ֖ם וַיֵּשְׁב֥וּ תַחְתָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘am gā·ḏō·wl wə·raḇ wā·rām kā·‘ă·nā·qîm way·yaš·mî·ḏêm Yah·weh mip·pə·nê·hem way·yî·rā·šum way·yê·šə·ḇū ṯaḥ·tām
verses.literal: They were a people great and many as tall as the Anakites But the LORD destroyed them from before the Ammonites who drove them out and settled in their place
verses.literalPt: povo grande, e numeroso, e alto, como os anaquins; Jeová os destruiu diante dos amonitas; e estes, tendo-os desapossado, habitavam no lugar deles;

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ לִבְנֵ֣י עֵשָׂ֔ו הַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בְּשֵׂעִ֑יר אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִשְׁמִ֤יד אֶת־ הַחֹרִי֙ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֔ם וַיִּֽירָשֻׁם֙ וַיֵּשְׁב֣וּ תַחְתָּ֔ם עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh liḇ·nê ‘ê·śāw hay·yō·šə·ḇîm bə·śê·‘îr ’ă·šer hiš·mîḏ ’eṯ- ha·ḥō·rî mip·pə·nê·hem way·yî·rā·šum way·yê·šə·ḇū ṯaḥ·tām ‘aḏ hay·yō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: just as He had done for the descendants of Esau who lived in Seir when He destroyed the Horites from before them They drove them out and have lived in their place to this day
verses.literalPt: assim como fez pelos filhos de Esaú, que habitam em Seir, quando de diante deles destruiu os horeus. Os filhos de Esaú, tendo-os desapossado, habitaram no lugar deles até este dia;

verses.original: וְהָֽעַוִּ֛ים הַיֹּשְׁבִ֥ים בַּחֲצֵרִ֖ים עַד־ עַזָּ֑ה כַּפְתֹּרִים֙ הַיֹּצְאִ֣ים מִכַּפְתּ֔וֹר הִשְׁמִידֻ֖ם וַיֵּשְׁב֥וּ תַחְתָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·‘aw·wîm hay·yō·šə·ḇîm ba·ḥă·ṣê·rîm ‘aḏ- ‘az·zāh kap̄·tō·rîm hay·yō·ṣə·’îm mik·kap̄·tō·wr hiš·mî·ḏum way·yê·šə·ḇū ṯaḥ·tām
verses.literal: And the Avvim who lived in villages as far as Gaza were destroyed by the Caphtorites who came out of Caphtor and settled in their place
verses.literalPt: e os avins, que habitavam em vilas até Gaza, foram destruídos pelos caftorins que saíram de Caftor e habitaram no lugar deles.).

verses.original: ק֣וּמוּ סְּע֗וּ וְעִבְרוּ֮ אֶת־ נַ֣חַל אַרְנֹן֒ רְאֵ֣ה נָתַ֣תִּי בְ֠יָדְךָ אֶת־ סִיחֹ֨ן מֶֽלֶךְ־ חֶשְׁבּ֧וֹן הָֽאֱמֹרִ֛י וְאֶת־ אַרְצ֖וֹ הָחֵ֣ל רָ֑שׁ וְהִתְגָּ֥ר בּ֖וֹ מִלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: qū·mū sə·‘ū wə·‘iḇ·rū ’eṯ- na·ḥal ’ar·nōn rə·’êh nā·ṯat·tî ḇə·yā·ḏə·ḵā ’eṯ- sî·ḥōn me·leḵ- ḥeš·bō·wn hā·’ĕ·mō·rî wə·’eṯ- ’ar·ṣōw hā·ḥêl rāš wə·hiṯ·gār bōw mil·ḥā·māh
verses.literal: Arise set out and cross the Arnon Valley See I have delivered into your hand Sihon the Amorite king of Heshbon and his land Begin to take possession of it and engage him in battle
verses.literalPt: Levantai-vos, parti e passai a torrente de Arnom; eis que entreguei nas tuas mãos a Seom, o amorreu, rei de Hesbom, e a sua terra; entra a desapossá-lo e faze-lhe a guerra.

verses.original: הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֗ה אָחֵל֙ תֵּ֤ת פַּחְדְּךָ֙ וְיִרְאָ֣תְךָ֔ עַל־ פְּנֵי֙ הָֽעַמִּ֔ים תַּ֖חַת כָּל־ הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִשְׁמְעוּן֙ שִׁמְעֲךָ֔ וְרָגְז֥וּ וְחָל֖וּ מִפָּנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: hay·yō·wm haz·zeh ’ā·ḥêl têṯ paḥ·də·ḵā wə·yir·’ā·ṯə·ḵā ‘al- pə·nê hā·‘am·mîm ta·ḥaṯ kāl- haš·šā·mā·yim ’ă·šer yiš·mə·‘ūn šim·‘ă·ḵā wə·rā·ḡə·zū wə·ḥā·lū mip·pā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: This very day I will begin to put the dread and fear of you upon all the nations under heaven They will hear the reports of you and tremble in anguish because of you
verses.literalPt: Hoje, começarei a meter o terror e o medo de ti aos povos que estão debaixo de todo o céu, de sorte que, ao ouvirdes a tua fama, tremam e se angustiem por causa de ti.

verses.original: וָאֶשְׁלַ֤ח מַלְאָכִים֙ מִמִּדְבַּ֣ר קְדֵמ֔וֹת אֶל־ סִיח֖וֹן מֶ֣לֶךְ חֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן דִּבְרֵ֥י שָׁל֖וֹם לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eš·laḥ mal·’ā·ḵîm mim·miḏ·bar qə·ḏê·mō·wṯ ’el- sî·ḥō·wn me·leḵ ḥeš·bō·wn diḇ·rê šā·lō·wm lê·mōr
verses.literal: So from the Wilderness of Kedemoth I sent messengers with an offer of peace to Sihon king of Heshbon saying
verses.literalPt: Então, do deserto de Quedemote, enviei mensageiros a Seom, rei de Hesbom, com palavras de paz, dizendo:

verses.original: אֶעְבְּרָ֣ה בְאַרְצֶ֔ךָ בַּדֶּ֥רֶךְ בַּדֶּ֖רֶךְ אֵלֵ֑ךְ לֹ֥א אָס֖וּר יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹֽאול׃
verses.transliteration: ’e‘·bə·rāh ḇə·’ar·ṣe·ḵā bad·de·reḵ bad·de·reḵ ’ê·lêḵ lō ’ā·sūr yā·mîn ū·śə·mō·wl
verses.literal: Let us pass through your land we will stay on the main road . . . . . . We will not turn to the right or to the left
verses.literalPt: Deixa-me passar pela tua terra; apenas pela estrada real irei; não me desviarei nem para a direita nem para a esquerda.

verses.original: אֹ֣כֶל בַּכֶּ֤סֶף תַּשְׁבִּרֵ֙נִי֙ וְאָכַ֔לְתִּי וּמַ֛יִם בַּכֶּ֥סֶף תִּתֶּן־ לִ֖י וְשָׁתִ֑יתִי רַ֖ק אֶעְבְּרָ֥ה בְרַגְלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·ḵel bak·ke·sep̄ taš·bi·rê·nî wə·’ā·ḵal·tî ū·ma·yim bak·ke·sep̄ tit·ten- lî wə·šā·ṯî·ṯî raq ’e‘·bə·rāh ḇə·raḡ·lāy
verses.literal: You can sell us food to eat and water to drink in exchange for silver Only let us pass through on foot
verses.literalPt: Vender-me-ás por dinheiro a comida, para que eu coma; e dar-me-ás por dinheiro a água, para que eu beba. Tão somente deixa-me passar a pé;

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר עָֽשׂוּ־ לִ֜י בְּנֵ֣י עֵשָׂ֗ו הַיֹּֽשְׁבִים֙ בְּשֵׂעִ֔יר וְהַמּ֣וֹאָבִ֔ים הַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בְּעָ֑ר עַ֤ד אֲשֶֽׁר־ אֶֽעֱבֹר֙ אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן אֶל־ הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·śū- lî bə·nê ‘ê·śāw hay·yō·šə·ḇîm bə·śê·‘îr wə·ham·mō·w·’ā·ḇîm hay·yō·šə·ḇîm bə·‘ār ‘aḏ ’ă·šer- ’e·‘ĕ·ḇōr ’eṯ- hay·yar·dên ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū nō·ṯên lā·nū
verses.literal: just as the descendants of Esau who live in Seir and the Moabites who live in Ar did for us until we cross the Jordan into the land that the LORD our God is giving us
verses.literalPt: assim como me fizeram os filhos de Esaú, que habitam em Seir, e os moabitas, que habitam em Ar; até que eu passe o Jordão e entre na terra que Jeová, nosso Deus, nos está dando.

verses.original: וְלֹ֣א אָבָ֗ה סִיחֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ חֶשְׁבּ֔וֹן הַעֲבִרֵ֖נוּ בּ֑וֹ כִּֽי־ הִקְשָׁה֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ אֶת־ רוּח֗וֹ וְאִמֵּץ֙ אֶת־ לְבָב֔וֹ לְמַ֛עַן תִּתּ֥וֹ בְיָדְךָ֖ כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·lō ’ā·ḇāh sî·ḥōn me·leḵ ḥeš·bō·wn ha·‘ă·ḇi·rê·nū bōw kî- hiq·šāh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’eṯ- rū·ḥōw wə·’im·mêṣ ’eṯ- lə·ḇā·ḇōw lə·ma·‘an tit·tōw ḇə·yā·ḏə·ḵā kay·yō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass through for the LORD your God had made his spirit stubborn and his heart obstinate that He might deliver him into your hand as is the case this day
verses.literalPt: Mas Seom, rei de Hesbom, não nos quis deixar passar por sua terra, porque Jeová, teu Deus, lhe endureceu o espírito e lhe fez obstinado o coração, para to entregar nas mãos, como hoje se vê.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔י רְאֵ֗ה הַֽחִלֹּ֙תִי֙ תֵּ֣ת לְפָנֶ֔יךָ אֶת־ סִיחֹ֖ן וְאֶת־ אַרְצ֑וֹ הָחֵ֣ל רָ֔שׁ לָרֶ֖שֶׁת אֶת־ אַרְצֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ê·lay rə·’êh ha·ḥil·lō·ṯî têṯ lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā ’eṯ- sî·ḥōn wə·’eṯ- ’ar·ṣōw hā·ḥêl rāš lā·re·šeṯ ’eṯ- ’ar·ṣōw
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to me See I have begun to deliver Sihon and his land over to you Now begin to conquer and possess his land
verses.literalPt: Disse-me, pois, Jeová: Eis que comecei a entregar-te Seom e a sua terra; entra a desapossá-lo, para que recebas por herança a sua terra.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵא֩ סִיחֹ֨ן לִקְרָאתֵ֜נוּ ה֧וּא וְכָל־ עַמּ֛וֹ לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה יָֽהְצָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê sî·ḥōn liq·rā·ṯê·nū hū wə·ḵāl ‘am·mōw lam·mil·ḥā·māh yā·hə·ṣāh
verses.literal: So Sihon and his whole army came out for battle against us at Jahaz
verses.literalPt: Então, Seom nos saiu ao encontro, ele e todo o seu povo, para nos dar batalha em Jaza.

verses.original: וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֛הוּ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ לְפָנֵ֑ינוּ וַנַּ֥ךְ אֹת֛וֹ וְאֶת־ בְּנוֹ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ עַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tə·nê·hū Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū lə·p̄ā·nê·nū wan·naḵ ’ō·ṯōw wə·’eṯ- bə·nō wə·’eṯ- kāl- ‘am·mōw
verses.literal: And the LORD our God delivered him over to us and we defeated him - and his sons and his whole army
verses.literalPt: Jeová, nosso Deus, no-lo entregou, e ferimo-lo, a ele, e a seus filhos, e a todo o seu povo.

verses.original: וַנִּלְכֹּ֤ד אֶת־ כָּל־ עָרָיו֙ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔וא וַֽנַּחֲרֵם֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ עִ֣יר מְתִ֔ם וְהַנָּשִׁ֖ים וְהַטָּ֑ף לֹ֥א הִשְׁאַ֖רְנוּ שָׂרִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: wan·nil·kōḏ ’eṯ- kāl- ‘ā·rāw bā·‘êṯ ha·hi·w wan·na·ḥă·rêm ’eṯ- kāl- ‘îr mə·ṯim wə·han·nā·šîm wə·haṭ·ṭāp̄ lō hiš·’ar·nū śā·rîḏ
verses.literal: At that time we captured all his cities and devoted to destruction the people of every city including women and children We left no survivors
verses.literalPt: Tomamos-lhes, nesse tempo, todas as cidades, e fizemos perecer totalmente os homens de cada cidade com as mulheres e os pequeninos, e não deixamos sobrevivente algum;

verses.original: רַ֥ק הַבְּהֵמָ֖ה בָּזַ֣זְנוּ לָ֑נוּ וּשְׁלַ֥ל הֶעָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָכָֽדְנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: raq hab·bə·hê·māh bā·zaz·nū lā·nū ū·šə·lal he·‘ā·rîm ’ă·šer lā·ḵā·ḏə·nū
verses.literal: We carried off for ourselves only the livestock and the plunder from the cities we captured
verses.literalPt: somente o gado, guardamo-lo por presa para nós, juntamente com o despojo das cidades que havíamos tomado.

verses.original: מֵֽעֲרֹעֵ֡ר אֲשֶׁר֩ עַל־ שְׂפַת־ נַ֨חַל אַרְנֹ֜ן וְהָעִ֨יר אֲשֶׁ֤ר בַּנַּ֙חַל֙ וְעַד־ הַגִּלְעָ֔ד לֹ֤א הָֽיְתָה֙ קִרְיָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׂגְבָ֖ה מִמֶּ֑נּוּ אֶת־ הַכֹּ֕ל נָתַ֛ן יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ לְפָנֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: mê·‘ă·rō·‘êr ’ă·šer ‘al- śə·p̄aṯ- na·ḥal ’ar·nōn wə·hā·‘îr ’ă·šer ban·na·ḥal wə·‘aḏ- hag·gil·‘āḏ lō hā·yə·ṯāh qir·yāh ’ă·šer śā·ḡə·ḇāh mim·men·nū ’eṯ- hak·kōl nā·ṯan Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū lə·p̄ā·nê·nū
verses.literal: From Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Valley along with the city in the valley even as far as Gilead not one city had walls too high for us The LORD our God gave us all of them
verses.literalPt: Desde Aroer, que está à beira da torrente de Arnom, e, desde a cidade que está no vale da torrente até Gileade, não houve cidade tão alta que não pudéssemos tomá-la; tudo no-lo entregou Jeová, nosso Deus;

verses.original: רַ֛ק אֶל־ אֶ֥רֶץ בְּנֵי־ עַמּ֖וֹן לֹ֣א קָרָ֑בְתָּ כָּל־ יַ֞ד נַ֤חַל יַבֹּק֙ וְעָרֵ֣י הָהָ֔ר וְכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֖ה יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: raq ’el- ’e·reṣ bə·nê- ‘am·mō·wn lō qā·rā·ḇə·tā kāl- yaḏ na·ḥal yab·bōq wə·‘ā·rê hā·hār wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū
verses.literal: But . . . you did not go near the land of the Ammonites . . . or the land along the banks of the Jabbok River or the cities of the hill country or any place that the LORD our God had forbidden
verses.literalPt: somente à terra dos filhos de Amom, a ela não chegaste, a saber, a toda a banda da torrente de Jaboque, e às cidades da região montanhosa, e a tudo o que Jeová, nosso Deus, nos proibiu.
